expected_behavior: Verification runs the tested command on its own, without chaining or piping, captures full output to a file, reports the tested process own exit status, and quotes the summary line as the evidence.
observation: A completion claim was drawn from a command whose exit status was not the tested process own status: success-chaining masks an earlier failure, a pipeline reports the last stage status, and block buffering reorders the summary line out of a captured excerpt so the visible evidence looks unrelated rather than absent.
